payload.title: File:Simonettoia tilaventina (holotype, MFSN 24992).png
payload.artist_html: S. Renesto, F. Saller, F. M. Dalla Vecchia
payload.credit_html: "'Simonettoia tilaventina, a new tanystropheid (Diapsida Archosauromorpha) from the Upper Triassic (Norian) of northeastern Italy"
payload.description_html: Simonettoia tilaventina, MFSN 24992, holotype. A) Main slab; B) counterslab; C-D) sketch of the exposed elements on the main slab and counterslab, respectively. The hyperelongated cervical vertebra is colored in blue. Abbreviations: cv, cervical vertebrae; cdv, caudal vertebrae; fe, femur; fi, fibula; h, humerus; il, ilium; is, ischium; lv, ‘lumbar’ vertebrae; mt I-IV, metatarsals I-IV; p, pubis; pg, elements of the pectoral girdle; ph, first phalanx of the fifth toe; ra, radius; sv1-2, sacral vertebrae 1-2; and u, ulna. Long bones and pelvic elements are left ones if not stated otherwise. Scale bar equals 20 mm
